blocks.text: The Civil Service Commissioners shall have the power to require by subpoena the attendance of witnesses and the production of books and papers, and the power to administer oaths. (Ord. 20206 § 28, 9-10-19; Ord. 16514 § 9(31-228), 9-15-92. Code 1995 § 106-51. Formerly 2.125.130.)
